ops.title: Update claim lock-loss assertions for the emptied backlink
ops.description:
ISSUES: 1

minor internal/cleanup/relocate/inplace_test.go:148 and :240 — Two stale diagnostic assertions fail after the new claim truncation. Both "the lock is gone" cases remove the owned lock after claim. bind now rejects the empty backlink first, returning "<admin> has no backlink and no lock of job <id>"; the tests still expect "<admin> no longer carries job <id>'s lock". Fix both expected strings; keep the identity blockage assertions.

Affected cases:
- TestAdmitReprovesAPartlyDeletedTree/the_lock_is_gone: expected detail at internal/cleanup/relocate/inplace_test.go:148; assertion at :169.
- TestAdmitReprovesAClaimedTree/the_lock_is_gone: expected detail at internal/cleanup/relocate/inplace_test.go:240; assertion at :259.

Validation: go test ./internal/cleanup/relocate/ -run 'Claim|Admit|Retire|Cancel' -count=1 ran once, under the shared runtime slot with GOMAXPROCS=2 and a private scratch TMPDIR. It failed only those two subtests; package duration 76.708s. No full suite or daemon tests ran. git diff --check passed. Source and existing diff were left unchanged.

Sweep: every hunk in docs/worktree-cleanup.md, internal/cleanup/relocate/inplace.go, and internal/cleanup/relocate/inplace_test.go; all requested later-phase paths and relocation/daemon backlink/listing assertions. No additional functional defect found.

Ownership: claim returns before unregister if proof or lock fails; unregister is gated by held.native (inplace.go:541-561). Advance routes unbound/adopted/orphaned jobs to take (advance.go:158-162). bind accepts an empty backlink only with the job's owned lock (inplace.go:132-173).

Recovery: claim persists RetirementIntent before publishing a new lock and truncating (inplace.go:548-561). On a crash before PhaseClaimed, the journal remains logical with that intent; bind and Retire accept its owned empty backlink (inplace.go:147-156; retirement.go:190-204). Cancel restores Links.AdminGitdir only in its allowed preclaim phases and requires ownership for an empty backlink (retirement.go:454-461, 505-519). enter clears retirement on entering a physical phase (advance.go:121-134). Daemon scheduling uses journal phase/retirement rather than backlink contents (engine.go:1009-1050, 1102-1140, 1790-1800).

No additional test asserting an untouched backlink after claim was found. Daemon listing-preservation assertions concern maintained/preclaim jobs and do not call this new truncation; retired-admin helpers retain backlinks before Retire rather than after claim. Registration-changing maintenance requires a hold (docs/worktree-cleanup.md:113-117); no finding is raised for an excluded overlapping move/repair.

ops.text: Update the expected identity detail at inplace_test.go:148 and :240 to the no-backlink/no-lock diagnostic; retain both identity refusal checks.
Production claim/proof behavior remains unchanged while correcting the expectations.
